query: SELECT TOP 20 source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,pmra,pmdec,parallax,radial_velocity,ra_error,dec_error,pmra_error,pmdec_error,ruwe,phot_g_mean_mag,astrometric_params_solved,phot_variable_flag FROM gaia_dr3_source WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',248.16761083294998,66.75497941722,0.003))=1 ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag
